name.description: The app's name, as in the server.yml entry.

compose.description: Compose files, relative to the app root, in order. No Traefik label, no platform network: routes say how the app is reached.

routes.description: How the app is reached: each route a host (and path) to a service's port. Read at the commit being deployed; a new host needs kayra apps.

host.description: Its hostname, <host>.<domain>. The app's hosts are its routes' hosts.

path.description: A path prefix: the route answers below it, and beats its host's route without one.

service.description: The compose service that answers it.

port.description: The port that service listens on, inside its container.

rate_limit.description: A rate limit on this route, per client address (Traefik's rateLimit).

average.description: Requests a client may send per period, on average.

burst.description: Requests a client may send at once beyond the average.

check.description: A path that answers 2xx or 3xx once the app is ready; a deploy waits for it. Without one, the route's own path must answer below 500.

secrets.description: Secret keys; their values come from the fleet's apps/<app>.secrets.yml.

config.description: Config keys; their values come from the fleet's apps/<app>.yml.
